Use case: stylized-concept. Production high resolution transparent game sprite atlas for MELIA ANTIQUA from Xenoblade, based strictly on attached reference motion sheet. Preserve her design: slender young adult woman, very long pale lavender/silver hair, blue eyes, small feather wings at BOTH temples, white/lilac/indigo ornate short layered dress with gold trim, detached flowing sleeves and ribbons, thigh-high pale stockings and purple/gold boots. Ornate LONG gold staff with a circular cyan-blue gem/winged head. Correct original proportions; do not turn into child or giant fairy. Premium polished anime cel shading with clean detailed linework. Reference is character identity and costume anchor.
EXACT48 separate complete full-body sprites in a strict8 columns x6 rows atlas, equal cells, intended3072x2304 high resolution. Transparent PNG actual alpha. Whole figure including staff tip, head wings, hair and soles must fit ENTIRELY within each cell with transparent gutters. SAME head/body scale across all cells. No captions, numbers, grid, scenery, ground, opponents, extra character, magic circles, glow trails or large effects painted into these sprites. Staff is physically held with consistent scale. Action poses face RIGHT except explicit backward attack.
ROW1 indexes0to7: 0 neutral upright standing staff at side three-quarter right;1 walking;2 running leaning right hair flowing;3 crouch holding staff low;4 jump lifting staff;5 falling;6 staff jab thrust right;7 return horizontal staff sweep right.
ROW2 indexes8to15:8 upward staff sweep;9 extended forward staff thrust right;10 midair spinning staff across body;11 low crouching staff sweep right;12 wide strong staff strike right;13 staff raised to summon upward;14 BACKWARD staff magic casting LEFT while torso facing right;15 upward aerial staff thrust.
ROW3 indexes16to23:16 downward staff plunge;17 free hand reaching to grab RIGHT with staff in other hand;18 close magic palm push RIGHT;19 free hand pushing throw RIGHT;20 defensive stance staff diagonal;21 hit recoil left;22 lying on side;23 smiling victory staff vertical.
ROW4 indexes24to31:24to27 FOUR consecutive walk cycle steps, left front/passing/right front/passing;28to31 FOUR consecutive run cycle steps, extended/passing/opposite extended/passing. Must visibly alternate feet, same body dimensions.
ROW5 indexes32to39:32 jump squat;33 rising jump;34 second jump with hair flared;35 falling upright;36 landing crouch;37 getup from lying;38 ledge hang facing RIGHT with one free hand high toward invisible right wall, staff held downward by other hand, feet BELOW torso;39 climbing RIGHT ledge.
ROW6 indexes40to47:40 summon element casting staff pointing right;41 place magic circle casting staff toward ground RIGHT;42 wing-flight start floating staff at side arms apart;43 wing-flight glide RIGHT with long hair flowing;44 flight end descent;45 change element holding free hand at chest;46 taunt quietly conversing with small invisible spirit, no spirit drawn;47 regal confident victory looking up staff at side.
Faithful original Melia costume and silhouette in EVERY cell, all poses full body, very clean transparent edges. No text.

Edit target: first attached generated Melia sprite atlas. Supporting reference: original Melia motion sheet. Change ONLY sprite sheet layout and padding. Preserve every full-body Melia pose, face, proportions, costume, staff and painting style from target. The current grid is too tight: several staffs and hair touch neighbouring cells or canvas edges. Fix this.
Return EXACT8 columns x6 rows, same48 poses in SAME row-major order. Move each complete sprite to the CENTER of its own equal cell, shrink whole sprites uniformly if needed so every tip of every staff, feather, hair, boot fits entirely inside its own cell with at least24px clear transparent gutter on every side. Keep body size uniform across all48 (allow raised staff to use top padding, never zoom the figure). Never clip any limbs or staff tips. Reconstruct any missing staff tip or clipped hair faithfully using original design. No overlap, no loose objects, no duplicated bodies, no captions, no grid lines. Use large3072x2304 canvas if possible. Truly transparent PNG alpha, no backdrop or white halo. Clean original crisp anime cel game sprites. Do not modify clothing, face or identity, do not add magic effects or backgrounds. Only repair cell spacing and complete clipped parts.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game VFX and portrait atlas for Melia Antiqua, matching provided Xenoblade character sheet. EXACT3 columns x4 rows of12 isolated complete items, equal cells with generous gutters, intended1536x2048 canvas. Actual transparent alpha, no labels, no frames, no scenery, no opponents or ground backgrounds.
ROW1 cell0: blue/cyan to purple crescent ether staff slash, sweeping RIGHT with tail on LEFT; cell1: elegant horizontal elliptical violet magic circle with fine concentric runes and rings, seen at shallow overhead angle for a placed spell; cell2: small cluster of luminous blue ice crystals erupting upward from transparent base.
ROW2 cell3: bright red/orange summoned FIRE SPIRIT orb with flame tendrils; cell4: blue ICE SPIRIT orb with crystal facets; cell5: golden LIGHTNING SPIRIT orb with fine lightning branching.

ROW4 cell9: compact golden-white violet hit impact spark; cell10: four small luminous element sigils orbiting a violet circle for element-change cast; cell11: beautiful sharp HEAD AND SHOULDERS portrait of MELIA ANTIQUA, long pale lavender/silver hair, BLUE eyes, pale small feather wings at both temples, ornate white/lilac/indigo outfit with gold trim, consistent with original attached design, gentle focused expression looking three-quarter RIGHT. Keep original identity, do not create a different woman.
Premium polished anime rendering matching reference. Only effect items in cells0to10 and portrait in cell11. Absolutely no character body figures in effects. All details fit inside own cell, no cropping.

Production transparent game sprite atlas of MELIA ANTIQUA, exactly24 complete full-body poses in6 columns x4 rows, equal cells, landscape1536x1024 or larger. Then28 RUN extended stride left footforward/rightback and29 run passing stride with rear leg lifting. All move RIGHT; actual leg positions must alternate visibly.

ROW3:36 landing crouch;37 rising to stand;38 ledge hanging with ONE free hand held HIGH toward invisible ledge on RIGHT, body and boots hanging BELOW hand, staff in opposite hand downward safely within cell;39 climbing invisible right ledge;40 summoning pose staff extending RIGHT;41 casting placed magic at ground RIGHT.
ROW4:42 wing flight start, floating upright, staff at side;43 gliding diagonally RIGHT with hair and ribbons flowing;44 descent after flight;45 changing element free hand near chest staff at side;46 quietly addressing invisible small spirit with freehand (do not draw spirit);47 regal victory gaze up staff vertical.
Match approved source character painting style and scale. Treat movement as whole-body frames; no modular rig or joint fragments. Full figure in every cell, isolated transparent.
